conditions: Variance shares are within-band accounting under the P43/P44 band qualifications (first-order normal plus conservative floor, covariance-covered subset) — not posterior probabilities over model error.

The roadmap draft's marginal band-reduction column under declared measurement improvements was narrowed to share ranking by the frozen protocol; buy-down numbers are a natural follow-on of the same table.
unranked names the coverage boundary (count + sensitivity L2 per family); it does not quantify what an uncovered channel would contribute.
The independent checker covers single-spectrum runs; multi-spectrum specs are rejected honestly rather than approximated.
